name: Dymatize ISO100 Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Powder (Gourmet Vanilla)
whyItWorks: Pre-hydrolyzed whey protein isolate that breaks long polypeptide chains into smaller peptide fractions for lightning-fast enzymatic assimilation. Contains <0.5g lactose and zero fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 1 scoop into 6-8 oz water or lactose-free milk using a handheld frother or shaker.
